changeSet.author: patrick_schmitz
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE wiki ( id INTEGER DEFAULT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, uuid TEXT DEFAULT NULL, fk_object_type_id INTEGER DEFAULT 31 REFERENCES object_type (id), name TEXT(250) NOT NULL , description TEXT DEFAULT NULL, fk_project_id INTEGER DEFAULT NULL REFERENCES project (id), fk_user_id INTEGER DEFAULT NULL, fk_object_persistence_method_id INTEGER DEFAULT NULL REFERENCES object_persistence_method (id), fk_datamanagement_process_id INTEGER DEFAULT NULL REFERENCES datamanagement_process (id), UNIQUE (name, fk_project_id, fk_user_id) );

CREATE TABLE wiki_log ( log_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, log_datetime TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, log_action TEXT, id INTEGER, uuid TEXT, fk_object_type_id INTEGER, fk_object_type_uuid TEXT, name TEXT(250), description TEXT, fk_project_id INTEGER, fk_project_uuid TEXT, fk_user_id INTEGER, fk_object_persistence_method_id INTEGER, fk_object_persistence_method_uuid TEXT, fk_datamanagement_process_id INTEGER, fk_datamanagement_process_uuid TEXT );

CREATE TRIGGER TRIG_wiki_Check_Business_Rule BEFORE INSERT ON wiki FOR EACH ROW WHEN ( (IFNULL(NEW.fk_project_id,-1) >0 AND IFNULL(NEW.fk_user_id,-1) >0) OR ((SELECT COUNT(name) FROM wiki WHERE name=NEW.name AND IFNULL(fk_project_id,-1)=IFNULL(NEW.fk_project_id,-1) AND IFNULL(fk_user_id,-1)=IFNULL(NEW.fk_user_id,-1))>0) ) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Invalid combination: Only scope project or user or none of them then it is global. Each wiki must be unique for every scope.') ; END;

CREATE VIEW "v_wiki_SearchInterface" AS SELECT wiki.id ,COALESCE(CAST(wiki.uuid AS varchar(100)), '') AS uuid ,wiki.fk_object_type_id ,COALESCE(wiki.name, '') AS name ,COALESCE(wiki.description, '') AS description ,project.fk_client_id ,COALESCE(project.name, '') AS project_name ,COALESCE(client.name, '') AS client_name ,wiki.fk_project_id ,wiki.fk_user_id FROM wiki LEFT JOIN project ON project.id = wiki.fk_project_id LEFT JOIN client ON client.id = project.fk_client_id ;

CREATE TABLE public.wiki ( id int8 GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY( INCREMENT BY 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 START 1 CACHE 1 NO CYCLE) NOT NULL, "uuid" uuid DEFAULT md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text)::uuid NULL, fk_object_type_id int8 DEFAULT '31'::bigint NULL, "name" text NULL, description text NULL, fk_project_id int8 NULL, fk_user_id int8 NULL, fk_object_persistence_method_id int8 NULL, fk_datamanagement_process_id int8 NULL, CONSTRAINT idx_48680_wiki_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT wiki_fk_datamanagement_process_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (fk_datamanagement_process_id) REFERENCES public.datamanagement_process(id), CONSTRAINT wiki_fk_object_persistence_method_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (fk_object_persistence_method_id) REFERENCES public.object_persistence_method(id), CONSTRAINT wiki_fk_object_type_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (fk_object_type_id) REFERENCES public.object_type(id), CONSTRAINT wiki_fk_project_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (fk_project_id) REFERENCES public.project(id) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_48680_sqlite_autoindex_wiki_1 ON public.wiki USING btree (name, fk_project_id, fk_user_id);

CREATE TABLE public.wiki_log ( log_id int8 GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY( INCREMENT BY 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 START 1 CACHE 1 NO CYCLE) NOT NULL, log_datetime timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NULL, log_action text NULL, id int8 NULL, "uuid" uuid NULL, fk_object_type_id int8 NULL, fk_object_type_uuid uuid NULL, "name" text NULL, description text NULL, fk_project_id int8 NULL, fk_project_uuid uuid NULL, fk_user_id int8 NULL, fk_object_persistence_method_id int8 NULL, fk_object_persistence_method_uuid uuid NULL, fk_datamanagement_process_id int8 NULL, fk_datamanagement_process_uuid uuid NULL, CONSTRAINT idx_48686_wiki_log_pkey PRIMARY KEY (log_id) );

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public."v_wiki_SearchInterface" AS SELECT wiki.id, COALESCE(wiki.uuid::character varying(100), ''::character varying) AS uuid, wiki.fk_object_type_id, COALESCE(wiki.name, ''::text) AS name, COALESCE(wiki.description, ''::text) AS description, project.fk_client_id, COALESCE(project.name, ''::text) AS project_name, COALESCE(client.name, ''::text) AS client_name, wiki.fk_project_id, wiki.fk_user_id FROM wiki LEFT JOIN project ON project.id = wiki.fk_project_id LEFT JOIN client ON client.id = project.fk_client_id;
changeSet.comment: Add new tables for wiki pages Used objects: wiki wiki_log Phabricator tasks: T799
